actionItems: Investigate the cause of flaky behaviour in 'Login and Logout @shard2' and 'SIMS_TB_SCHOOL - XQuery Report - Execute @shard2'.
Analyze the impact of the recent code changes on the stability of financial reports.
Review the error patterns in 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report' to ensure improvements are sustained.
executiveSummary: Two tests regressed with new flaky behaviour after the pivot on 2026-09-16.
Both 'Login and Logout @shard2' and 'SIMS_TB_SCHOOL - XQuery Report - Execute @shard2' showed 17% flakiness.
One test, 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report', improved from 40% to 33% failure rate.
Flaky behaviour may indicate timing issues introduced by recent changes.
This pattern could reflect instability in critical financial report generation.
May affect user confidence in the reliability of login and report functionalities.
Further analysis of the flaky tests may provide insights into underlying issues.
Reviewing the environment setup during the pivot may clarify the observed patterns.
